purpose: Review examples; this file is not a deployed system or a full JSON Schema. Roof pilot is conditional on actual candidate comparison; plans are not dispatched.

sources.instruction_handling: Content is review material, not task authorization.

support_refs.selector: ZIP central directory; all non-directory entries read; CRC checked

confidence.basis: Counted and read all archive entries. Manifest lists 13 content files, excluding itself.

proposed_objects.description: A limited roof patch based on the best available traceable local references.
constraints: Relative-shape experiments may proceed when explicitly marked as such.
Do not convert unknown file units to metres.
Do not claim historical date, installation type, or calibrated physical response without supporting evidence.

decisions.proposed_change: Select a bounded existing production failure using evidence availability, a defensible acceptance reference, current rework, and correction cost; a roof patch is one candidate.
decisions.scope: Conditional pilot selection. No project-wide best-asset claim or calendar commitment.
alternatives: Use another local asset with stronger source evidence and an accepted baseline.
consequences: Keeps the first integration limited to architecture, tiles, material, and a defined environment input.
decisions.reopen_when: A materially better evidenced pilot asset is identified or the roof sample cannot test the target failures.

tasks.goal: Demonstrate traceable correction, regression detection, and a usable handoff on one limited object.
independent_next_steps: Use the existing project inventory to check whether this candidate is suitable; do not recreate a full inventory.
Design known-bad and valid control fixtures

experiments.hypothesis: Explicit structural checks can reject a known-invalid support configuration even when the usual front view is similar.
experiments.prediction: Removing a support declared necessary in the test fixture triggers a structural failure; its valid control passes.
changed_variables: One support relationship and its corresponding test geometry
experiments.evaluation_plan: Use a fixture with specified support requirements; compare relation check and underside/section views. This demonstrates test behaviour, not unknown historical construction.

required_before_production_acceptance: Explicit acceptance for the stated scope
